paragraphs.text: Poison Snake is an obsolete creature type for a race of artificial poisonous snakes .

Poison Snake originally debuted as a two-worded creature type in Legends on tokens created by Serpent Generator . It has an activated ability that creates 1/1 Snake artifact creatures for 4 colorless mana . The generated snakes give poison counters whenever they deal damage to players. With the release of the Magic Online Masters Edition , the artifact was given errata to create tokens with just the Snake type instead.
